final: WITH counts AS (SELECT o.recordvault AS order_reference, o.orderflow AS status, COUNT(*) AS record_count FROM riskandmargin AS r JOIN orders AS o ON r.ordervault = o.recordvault GROUP BY o.recordvault, o.orderflow), shares AS (SELECT order_reference, status, record_count, 1.0 * record_count / SUM(record_count) OVER (PARTITION BY status) AS share FROM counts), gaps AS (SELECT order_reference, status, record_count, share, share - AVG(share) OVER (PARTITION BY status) AS gap_above_average FROM shares) SELECT order_reference, status, record_count, share, gap_above_average FROM gaps ORDER BY gap_above_average DESC LIMIT 10
